mapper.update: WITH input(user_id,fingerprint,at,ip) AS MATERIALIZED ( VALUES (#{uid}::bigint,#{r.key}::uuid,#{r.moment}::timestamptz,#{r.ip}::inet) ), observed AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ua.owner,i.fingerprint,i.at,i.user_id AS reporter FROM input i JOIN userapps_heartbeat hb ON hb.ip=i.ip AND hb.first_seen_at <= i.at AND hb.last_seen_at >= i.at JOIN userapp ua ON ua.id=hb.userapp_id WHERE ua.owner <> i.user_id AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM user_account_deletion_request d WHERE d.user_id=ua.owner AND d.status='COMPLETED') ), added AS ( INSERT INTO user_career_events(user_id,kind,fingerprint,observed_at,reporter_id) SELECT user_id,'ban',fingerprint,at,NULL::bigint FROM input UNION ALL SELECT owner,'observation',fingerprint,at,reporter FROM observed ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING RETURNING user_id,kind,observed_at ) INSERT INTO user_career_daily AS d(user_id,day,kind,amount) SELECT user_id,(observed_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date,kind,COUNT(*) FROM added GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY 1,3,2 ON CONFLICT(user_id,kind,day) DO UPDATE SET amount=d.amount+EXCLUDED.amount

WITH input(fingerprint,at) AS (VALUES (#{r.key}::uuid,#{r.moment}::timestamptz)), added AS ( INSERT INTO user_career_events(user_id,kind,fingerprint,observed_at) SELECT a.owner,'feature',i.fingerprint,i.at FROM userapp a CROSS JOIN input i WHERE a.id=#{uid} ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING RETURNING user_id,kind,observed_at ) INSERT INTO user_career_daily AS d(user_id,day,kind,amount) SELECT user_id,(observed_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date,kind,COUNT(*) FROM added GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY 1,3,2 ON CONFLICT(user_id,kind,day) DO UPDATE SET amount=d.amount+EXCLUDED.amount
